neighbours.label: online advertising and earning money from web content (Google ads, sponsored posts, affiliate links, monetize), as opposed to ads on paper and to the same earning and shopping words offline
fire: Many YouTubers make a living from Ads and brand deals these days.
Facebook started showing video ads in the middle of its news feed.
She decided to monetize her cooking blog with display banners.
Google Shopping lets retailers pay for a spot at the top of the results.
His podcast earns most of its income through Ads and listener tips.
Our site gets paid every time a visitor clicks on one of the banner ads.
The company now sells sponsored posts to anyone with a big Instagram following.
Influencers often use affiliate links to monetize their product reviews.
quiet: Many farmers make a living from sheep and wool these days.
The newspaper started printing job ads in the middle of its weekend edition.
She decided to decorate her cooking room with painted tiles.
The corner grocer lets neighbours pay for their shopping at the end of the month.
His bakery earns most of its income through bread and wedding cakes.
Our church gets paid every time a visitor rents one of the old rooms.
The company now sells garden tools to anyone with a big backyard.
Teachers often use flash cards to review their weekly lessons.
